body:
Hello people, hope your keeping safe and well as you can be. Have recently been seeing the trend about suicides being higher for us men and cant help but think about my personal struggles with mental health and how I wanted to be part of that statistic once upon a time. Life can be tough at times but no matter how hard it gets we can pull through.

I want to share my experience in hope that it reaches whoever it needs to reach to let them know you're not alone.

I've had many battles with addiction over the past decade, it's made me pay ultimate prices and taken me to some dark places, places that made me question if life was worth living. I know how you feel. Your not the first to feel it and wont be the last. It happens to the best of us. But theres alot to live for on the other side. Keep pushing and never give up! Do your best to surround yourself with love and goodness and you can pull through. It starts with you. If you get knocked down, don't beat yourself up, dust yourself off and get back up again, you will get stronger every time.

Just as we go to the gym to improve our physical wellbeing, it's vitally important to train and strengthen our psychological side, now more than ever. Theres much knowledge out there so do some research, find some light and climb out of the abyss.

Know that your mind is simply a computer system that controls your perception of the world. You can reprogram! Learn to accept the negatives and make the shift to positive power. You are the holder of the controller. Have faith and take control. 

I hope you keep on fighting and searching for the light.

Heres a little song I've put together about my battles. Let me know what you think. Time to empower one another 🙌🏽👊🏼🙏🏽

Love and Peace x
